items.title: Hackers Use Fake Purchase Order Emails to Deliver XLoader Malware Through Malicious Word Documents
items.description:
Hackers are sending fake purchase order emails to trick recipients into opening Word documents that deliver XLoader, an information-stealing malware. The attack uses an embedded document, an old Microsoft Equation Editor vulnerability, and several script stages to reach its final payload.
